models_evaluated: deep learning ECG-based multi-day AF risk prediction model

links.outcome: Physician AF risk discrimination with versus without AI assistance in simulated cases
links.effect: AI assistance improved physicians' AF risk discrimination (AUROC 0.573 to 0.650) and NPV (0.764 to 0.839); NRI 0.127 for non-AF cases, p < 0.001.
links.quote: AI assistance significantly improved physicians' AF risk discrimination (AUROC 0.573 to 0.650) and negative predictive value (0.764 to 0.839), with significant net reclassification improvement for non-AF cases (NRI 0.127, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Model AUROC internal versus external cohort performance
links.effect: ECG-labeled AUROC 0.79 in internal EUMC cohort versus 0.74 in external BIDMC cohort; Holter-labeled 0.87 internal versus 0.75 prospective.
links.quote: For ECG-labeled outcomes, the model achieved an AUROC of 0.79 in the internal EUMC cohort and 0.74 in the external BIDMC cohort.

screen.reason: Evaluated the impact of providing AI-derived risk estimates versus standard judgment on physician clinical decision-making and risk discrimination in a simulated vignette study.
